content_zh:
1月13日，他说感觉到有人在看着他，很多很多人，并称自己很害怕……
1月16日，他似乎不再害怕了，时而露出微笑，但变得沉默寡言……
1月17日，所有测试结果正常，我们六人中没有一个能解释这孩子身上发生的事情……
1月19日，他开始画画，尽管他的父母表示，过去他从未展现出任何绘画才能，但他却能画出十分逼真的素描……
1月22日，他不断地索要纸张和铅笔，不眠不休地作画，他只画人的脸，而且画像中的人脸从一开始的平常模样，变得越来越怪诞可怖……
1月25日，墙上出现了用血画的人脸，我们在他病房的地上找到了一只麻雀的尸体，他手上很干净，这令我不安起来，我想起了那个汤匙……
1月26日，那条走廊里的窗户竟全部都消失了，剩下密不透风的墙，前一晚的监控录像只拍到一片模糊的影像，我也不知道该请求谁的帮助？警察吗？他们会以为我疯了而把我关起来……
1月30日，李察失踪了，我们其余五人都变得很不安，墙上又出现了更多的血脸，这次我们甚至没有找到……我不知道……他的尸体？
1月31日，我得离开这儿……我应该请求休假，直到这孩子因病去世……不……辞职更好！
2月1日，我想我逃不出去了，这栋建筑里已找不到可以出去的路……如果有人看到这本笔记，请死的会是你！”
…………
封不觉和王叹之一同经过了那个转角，前方的走廊还是很敞亮，但这次没有门，两边都是雪白的墙壁，再往前几十米，又有一个丁字路口。
两人小心翼翼地前行，封不觉把笔记本的内容稍加提炼后复述了一下，他尽量说得不那么吓人，但还是把小叹同学吓得脸色刷白，起了一身鸡皮疙瘩。
“我们要面对的不是鬼魂，而是在得了重病以后受到精神污染的超能力儿童。”封不觉总结道，“至少这个剧本是这么设定。”
“知道了这些又能有什么帮助啊……”王叹之的口吻表示他的压力依然很大。
“首先，在心理上，知道了对方是个人，我想你恐惧的程度也会稍微减弱几分。”封不觉回道，“其次，实际意义在于，我们知道，他是有实体的，可以直接上去K他。”
“喂……你觉得写笔记本的人，还有这个剧本里的其他受害者……就没有试过吗？”王叹之一脸惊惶，“他们在人数上不止两个吧？”
“他们会爆炸神拳吗？”封不觉问道。
“觉哥，我有个疑问……要是我们没有找到这个技能，或者正巧我们俩的格斗专精都没开启，又或者根本没有进行解谜，那会是什么状况？”
“那我们在遇见他以后，会面临一个选择。”封不觉道，“究竟是跟他拼了，还是逃跑。”他考虑几秒，再道，“没有解过谜的话，我们就得根据与其接触后的具体情况，比如受伤后的生存值损失多少来判断抉择。在恐惧和死亡威胁中，难度就偏高了。

但经过对剧本的了解后，此刻不用接触我也基本能确信……以我们的战斗能力而言，只能逃跑，硬拼肯定死。所以我想……这个剧本的通关方法，应该有一种是逃出通关。”
“那我们现在的危险程度岂不是和没有解过谜一样啊！”王叹之道。
“不，有区别。至少在第二个房间，你获得了一个技能。”封不觉道，“在第三个房间，我们还得知了他的弱点，那么此刻无论是选择干掉他还是逃跑通关，成功率都得到了相当的提升。”
“我那个20%的技能先不谈，你不是说关于他弱点的那行字被一块血污给遮住了吗？”
“系统在这里安排了一个十分简单的推理，结合笔记的上下文，分析这孩子所做的一系列行为……剔除那些不重要的修饰或迷惑人的部份，这笔迹的内容基本就和怪物档案一样明晰。”封不觉说这话时，他们又经过了一个转角，前方出现了一个宽广的大堂，天花板的高度升高了，照明依旧很好，但周围依旧全是墙壁。

content_en:
On January 13, he said he felt someone was watching him, many, many people, and said he was scared...
On January 16, he seemed to be no longer afraid, smiling from time to time, but became taciturn...
On January 17th, all tests came back normal and none of the six of us could explain what was happening to this child…
On January 19, he started drawing, and although his parents said he had never shown any talent for drawing in the past, he was able to draw very realistic sketches...
On January 22, he kept asking for paper and pencils, and painted without sleep. He only painted people's faces, and the faces in the paintings became more and more grotesque and terrifying from their normal appearance at the beginning...
On January 25, human faces painted in blood appeared on the wall, and we found the body of a sparrow on the floor of his ward. His hands were very clean, which made me uneasy. I thought of the spoon...
On January 26, all the windows in that corridor disappeared, leaving only an airtight wall. The surveillance video from the previous night only captured a blurry image. I didn’t know who to ask for help? Police? They'll think I'm crazy and lock me up...
On January 30th, Richard disappeared, the remaining five of us became very uneasy, more bloody faces appeared on the wall, and this time we didn't even find... I don't know... his body?
I have to get out of here on January 31st...I should ask for leave until the kid dies of illness...no...it's better to resign!
On February 1st, I thought I could not escape. There was no way out of this building... If anyone sees this note, you will be the one to die! "
…………
Feng Bujue and Wang Tanzhi passed the corner together. The corridor ahead was still very open, but this time there was no door. There were white walls on both sides. A few dozen meters further, there was another T-shaped intersection.
The two of them moved forward cautiously. Feng Bujue refined the contents of the notebook and recited it. He tried his best to make it less scary, but it still frightened classmate Xiaotan so much that his face turned pale and he got goosebumps all over his body.
“We are not dealing with ghosts, but children with super powers who have been mentally contaminated after becoming seriously ill. "Feng Bujue concluded, "At least that's the setting of this script. "
"How can knowing this help..." Wang Tanzhi's tone indicated that he was still under great pressure.
"First of all, psychologically, once you know that the other person is a human being, I think your level of fear will be slightly reduced. Feng Bujue replied, "Secondly, the practical significance is that we know that he has a physical body and we can directly go up and kill him." "
"Hey... do you think the person who wrote the notebook and the other victims in this script... haven't tried it? Wang Tan looked horrified, "There are more than two of them, right?" "
“Are they going to explode God Fist? Feng Bujue asked.
"Brother Jue, I have a question... What would happen if we didn't find this skill, or if neither of us happened to have the combat specialization activated, or if we didn't solve the puzzle at all? "
“Then after we meet him, we will face a choice. Feng Bujue said, "Should we fight him or run away." He thought for a few seconds and then said, "If we haven't solved the mystery, we have to make a decision based on the specific situation after contact with it, such as the loss of survival points after being injured." In fear and death threats, the difficulty is on the high side.
But after understanding the script, I can basically be convinced without contact at this moment... In terms of our combat capabilities, we can only escape, and we will definitely die if we fight hard. So I think... there should be one way to clear this script, which is to escape and clear the level. "
"Then our current level of danger is the same as if we had never solved the mystery! "Wang Tanzhi said.
"No, there is a difference. At least in the second roomDuring this time, you gained a skill. "Feng Bujue said, "In the third room, we also learned about his weaknesses, so now whether we choose to kill him or escape and pass the level, the success rate has been greatly improved. "
"Let's not talk about my 20% skill. Didn't you say that the line about his weakness was covered by a piece of blood? "
"The system arranged a very simple reasoning here, combined with the context of the note, to analyze a series of actions performed by the child... excluding those unimportant embellishments or confusing parts, the content of this note is basically as clear as the monster file. "When Feng Bujue said this, they passed another corner, and a wide lobby appeared in front of them. The height of the ceiling was raised, and the lighting was still very good, but it was still surrounded by walls.
